# The ONE: shared settings for replaying a contact trace (bench/traces).
# Contacts and messages both come from an external events file, so every
# router sees exactly the same contacts and the same messages, and Mycel's
# bench (bench/mycel-bench) replays the identical inputs.
#
# Workload and node settings are ONE's defaults (default_settings.txt):
# 250 kB/s links, 5 MB buffers, TTL 300 min, messages every 25-35 s of
# 500 kB-1 MB between random devices (generated by convert.py workload).
# Spray-and-Wait uses L = 4 copies, Mycel's default (ONE's default is 6).

Scenario.simulateConnections = false
# The traces are 120 s-granular; 1 s steps lose nothing (Mycel's bench uses 1 s too).
Scenario.updateInterval = 1.0
Scenario.nrofHostGroups = 1

btInterface.type = SimpleBroadcastInterface
btInterface.transmitSpeed = 250k
btInterface.transmitRange = 10

Group.groupID = n
Group.movementModel = StationaryMovement
Group.nodeLocation = 10, 10
Group.bufferSize = 5M
Group.msgTtl = 300
Group.nrofInterfaces = 1
Group.interface1 = btInterface
Group.router = [EpidemicRouter; ProphetRouter; SprayAndWaitRouter; MaxPropRouter; DirectDeliveryRouter]

Events.nrof = 1
Events1.class = ExternalEventsQueue

MovementModel.rngSeed = 1
MovementModel.worldSize = 100, 100
MovementModel.warmup = 0

Report.nrofReports = 2
Report.warmup = 0
Report.report1 = MessageStatsReport
# per-message latencies: "delivered within T" over all created messages
Report.report2 = DeliveredMessagesReport

ProphetRouter.secondsInTimeUnit = 30
SprayAndWaitRouter.nrofCopies = 4
SprayAndWaitRouter.binaryMode = true

Optimization.cellSizeMult = 5
Optimization.randomizeUpdateOrder = true
